title: 第7章 族府大会第8章 杀！德玛西亚！
content_zh:
第七章 族府大会
当清晨的第一缕阳光破开云层，照耀到洛河城时，秦家终于迎来了一年一度的族府大会，秦家东府这时也是热闹非凡，随处可见一列列由秦家高手组成的卫队巡视着，手持长枪，威风凛凛，英姿飒爽，特别是他们身上不时溢出的气息，更是令人心生畏惧。
今天对于秦家而言可是最为重要的一天，由不得他们不谨慎小心，而秦家高层也敢确定，此时就算是一只麻雀，也别想飞进来，可见其防御程度之强。
东府校场。
上百名秦家四府的子弟列成数个方队站立着，统一的白色长衫，远看，就如一条长龙一般，极其壮观，近看，只见每个秦家子弟站得笔直，如一杆标枪，神色肃穆，眉宇间皆是有着一抹兴奋在其中。
好在校场的占地面积极广，就算站着百名秦家子弟也丝毫没显得拥挤，而在这百名秦家子弟前方则是一座三米高的高台，以及一座六米高的看台，几乎占据了半个校场。
一声声清脆悠扬的钟鸣，仿佛天宫中的仙乐一般，令人不禁沉沦进去，如痴如醉，可偏偏无法辨别这声音从哪里来，就如是从天上传来的，飘渺异常。
就在这时，伴随着‘仙乐’，一列十人左右的队伍飘然而至，落在那六米高的看台上，每一个都是气息浑厚，领头的乃是一名中年男子，身穿锦袍，衣阙飘飘，无风自动，东府府主秦云天！
旁边，赫然便是西府府主秦龙，此时秦龙眼里尽是睿智之色，笑容满面，与之前在东府大厅相比简直是两个反差，除此之外，在二人旁边还多了两名身材略显削瘦的男子，鼻头较高的南府府主秦明，以及宽额头的北府府主秦林，剩下的便是四府中的长老。
“哗。”
四大府主齐聚一堂，底下秦家子弟顿时一片哗然，个个脸色绯红，满是兴奋与激动之色，目光更是透着浓浓的崇拜和羡慕之意。
府主啊，秦家高高在上的存在啊，平时见一位都难，如今能四位都见到，如何能不激动？
双手往下一压，秦云天此刻表情也是凝重无比，身上透着一股淡淡的威压，令人为之侧目，等到全场安静下来，这才满意的点了点头。
“秦家立世上百年……”
由古至今，秦云天声音浑厚有力，虽然没有特意的在声音中灌入玄力，可却依然清晰的传入在场每一位秦家子弟的耳内。
一番慷慨激昂的演说下，虽然在场的一些秦家子弟已经不是第一次听了，但依旧满腔热血，个个摩拳擦掌，恨不得为秦家做一番大贡献。
“另外，此次族比中第一者，将会有机会得到一件重宝。”
“重宝？”
“我没听错吧？府主竟然说重宝？”
“你打我一下试试？靠，你还真打啊！”

秦云天的话音刚落，底下顿时一阵哗然，脸上尽是不可思议之色，但紧随即便是兴奋，浓浓的兴奋！
看台上，除了秦云天外，包括秦龙等三位府主，以及一干长老同样神色讶异，难以置信。
重宝，虽然不知道是什么重宝，但要知道，能被称之为重宝的，无一不是无价之宝，他们当中，还没有一个人拥有重宝的，而在神玄大陆上，一旦出现重宝，也是各路强者纷纷抢夺的对象。
想到这一点，除了三位府主外，众多长老不禁有些眼红，但也仅此而已，他们可不敢强抢，先不说四位府主的实力是不是他们对付得了的，秦家还有一位老祖宗以及几位老家伙在，那几位的实力更是深不可测，他们可还没嫌命长。
彼此对视了一眼，几位长老皆是看到了对方眼中的无奈，重宝这种东西，只能想想罢了。
秦云天并没有理会因为自己这句话而引起的轰动，示意主持这次大会的长老一眼，便独自朝看台一方飘然而去，他的事情已经做完了，接下来他只需等待结果就成了。
时间如流沙一般，整整花费了近一上午的时间来计算秦家这一年来的得失，以及荣耀，期间除了奖励一些对秦家有大贡献的子弟外，难免也揪出了几位贪污，在外败坏秦家的人渣。
也就在众人为那几名败坏秦家名声的子弟义愤填膺时，众人没发现的是，不知何时，六米高的看台上竟是多了一名老者！
只见其鹤发童颜，目光深邃，仿若黑洞一般，看上一眼就能让人陷进去，他身穿白色长袍，行走间就如融入了这片天地一般，只是简单的一步，便从几十米开外来到了秦云天的旁边，连秦云天四位府主都没发现！
“秦家竟发展到这般壮大了。”
悠然叹了口气，老者神情淡然，仿若不食人间烟火，然而也因为如此，秦云天几人连忙惊醒，就如被踩到尾巴的老鼠，寒毛根根竖立，体内的玄气瞬间爆发，一时间，恐怖的气浪以几人为中心朝四面八扩散而去，激起一层层烟沙，周围的空气似乎也因此变得压抑了下来。
要知道，他们当中实力最低也是气海镜中期，最高更是达到了凝神镜中期，能如此不知不觉来到他们身边，如果对方要杀他们的话……
包括秦云天在内，一群人的背后皆是被冷汗浸湿。
时间在这一刻凝固住了，并非夸张，而是真正的凝固了！除了看台上的一群人外，百名秦家子弟，包括那名主持长老在内，全部停在上一秒的动作！
轻轻挥了挥手，就如只是扫了一下前方的空气，由秦云天等人组成的恐怖气浪竟是被老者轻描淡写的化去，一切都烟消云散，而这时，秦云天一行人这才看清来人，这一看，顿时又是吓出一身冷汗。
“老……”
四大府主，一行长老就要上前跪拜，可是不论他们如何用力，双膝就是弯不下去。
“不必了，我就是来看看罢了，莫要声张。”随着话音刚落，看台下方的百名秦家子弟又恢复了自由，一切就如没发生过一般。
点了点头，以秦云天为首的几人也不再多说什么，可依旧让出一块座位，平时高高在上的四位府主此时就如四个乖巧的孩子，满是恭敬。
刚才老祖宗的实力他们可看得清清楚楚，心中的惊讶自然别提，那是越来越深不可测了，不过随即便暗自高兴，老祖宗的实力越强，就代表着秦家在洛河城的地位越稳固！

端坐于一旁，秦龙眼中则是不断闪烁着，不知在想些什么，只是掩饰得极好，并无人发现。
“现在我宣布，秦家族府大会，族比大赛开始！”
烈日当空，随着主持长老一声大喝，属于秦家年轻一辈的争斗终于拉开了帷幕，而今年明显与往年有所不同，毕竟有那‘重宝’的彩头放在那，秦家子弟一个个都拼足了劲，就算明知道没机会，也会冲上去拼一次。
轰轰轰！
玄气爆裂，土石飞溅，暴喝声与惨嚎声不绝入耳，不断有人跃上那三米高的石台，也不断有人飞下来。
“这小家伙是……”
看台上，老者望着下方的石台，此时那里正立着一道年轻的身影，全身气势如虹，玄气环绕，令人不敢小觑，无数上来挑战的秦家子弟皆是被其一一击败。
“回老祖宗，正是犬子，秦江伟。”西府府主秦龙连上前应道，眼里透着一股得意。
“不错，小小年纪便是炼体九重圆满，再给他几天的时间，便可突破了。”点了点头，老者的眼睛何等毒辣，自然一眼便看出了秦江伟的实力。
秦龙脸上不自觉的露出一股傲色，然而还未等他说话，便又听秦家老祖朝一旁的秦云天问道，“云天，听闻你也有一小子，比起这小家伙如何？”
秦家老祖的声音并没有刻意掩饰，另外三位府主以及众多长老皆可轻易听到，此时闻言不禁有些笑意，就连心里有些不平衡的秦龙，嘴角也是露出一抹嘲讽。
“老祖，那秦轩如今不过才炼体三重而已，怎能与秦江伟公子比。”旁边一名明显是西府的长老笑道，其他两府的长老也一脸笑容，而东府的几名长老则满脸尴尬。
秦家老祖点头，不再说话，而秦云天也没有解释的意思，同样笑了笑，炼体三重？怕是已经过去式了。
“秦轩，可敢出来一战？”
就在这时，石台上的秦江伟猛然一喝，中气十足，显然使上了玄气。
秦家一些中上游的子弟已经被他都一一击溃了，接下来便是一些真正的天才了，而对于天才，秦江伟还有点自知之明，虽然他已经达到了炼体九重圆满，差一步便可踏入气海镜，可秦家年轻一辈中他还不是第一，若是时间再拖下去，那家伙站出来的话，自己就没机会了！
所以，必须尽快让秦轩那小子出来！他可不会放弃这个践踏一名曾经对手的绝佳机会！
然而，随着时间的推移，秦轩的影子并没有出现，就仿佛这个人不存在于秦家一般，周围开始响起一声声低语，也无人再上去，就算几名实力与秦江伟差不多的家伙也抱臂观看起来。
“秦轩，出来！”
“难道你要做缩头乌龟不成？你可别忘了，昨日是谁约我一战的？”秦江伟不断叫嚣着，心中却丝毫不焦急，他不怕秦轩不出来，就算不出来，他也能令那小子从此在秦家四府抬不起头来！

果然，秦江伟的话音刚落，底下顿时炸开了锅，之前他们不知道实情，以为秦江伟以体悟九重的实力去欺负三重的秦轩，如果是这样，他们不屑，甚至是鄙视。
可是现在，竟然是后者主动提出的挑战！这不是找死吗？
是的，没人看好秦轩，毕竟在他们的印象里，两者相差了六阶，有人甚至都在笑秦轩不知死活，而有些东府的子弟则暗自祈祷，希望自家公子不要出来。
丢人？总比丢命的好。
“我敢提出挑战，我为何不敢出现？可笑！”
这时，吵闹声中，一道淡然的声音远远传来，充满了自信，霸道！

Chapter 7 Clan Government Meeting
When the first ray of sunshine in the morning broke through the clouds and shone into Luohe City, the Qin family finally ushered in the annual clan meeting. The East Mansion of the Qin family was also very lively at this time. Guards consisting of masters of the Qin family could be seen patrolling everywhere, holding long spears, majestic and heroic, especially the aura that leaked out from them from time to time, which was even more frightening.
Today is the most important day for the Qin family. They cannot help but be cautious, and the senior officials of the Qin family are sure that even a sparrow will not be able to fly in at this time, which shows how strong its defense is.
Dongfu Campus.
Hundreds of children from the four houses of the Qin family stood in several square formations, wearing uniform white robes. From a distance, they looked like a long dragon, which was extremely spectacular. From a closer look, each of the children of the Qin family stood upright, like a javelin, with solemn expressions and a touch of excitement between their brows.
Fortunately, the school ground covers a very large area, and even if there are hundreds of Qin family children standing there, it does not seem crowded at all. In front of these hundreds of Qin family children is a three-meter-high platform and a six-meter-high stand, occupying almost half of the school ground.
The clear and melodious ringing of bells is like the fairy music in the heavenly palace. People can't help but sink into it and become mesmerized. However, they can't tell where the sound comes from. It is as if it is coming from the sky, and it is extremely misty.
At this moment, accompanied by the "Xianle", a team of about ten people floated over and landed on the six-meter-high stand. Each one had a strong aura. The leader was a middle-aged man, wearing a brocade robe with fluttering skirts, and the master of the East Mansion, Qin Yuntian!
Next to them was Qin Long, the master of the West Palace. Qin Long's eyes were full of wisdom at this time and his face was full of smiles. Compared with the previous hall of the East Palace, there was a complete contrast. In addition, there were two slightly thinner men beside them, Qin Ming, the master of the South Palace with a tall nose, and Qin Lin, the master of the North Palace with a wide forehead. The rest were the elders of the four mansions.
"Wow."
The four masters of the palace gathered together, and the children of the Qin family were in an uproar. Their faces were all blushing, full of excitement and excitement, and their eyes were filled with deep admiration and envy.
Palace Master, the Qin family’s high-ranking presence, it’s hard to see even one of them in normal times, but now I can see all four of them, how can I not be excited?
Pressing his hands down, Qin Yuntian's expression was extremely solemn at this moment, and there was a faint pressure on his body, which made people look at him. When the whole place fell silent, he nodded with satisfaction.
"The Qin family has been around for hundreds of years..."
From ancient times to the present, Qin Yuntian's voice was rich and powerful. Although he did not intentionally pour profound energy into his voice, it was still clearly transmitted into the ears of every Qin family disciple present.
After an impassioned speech, although it was not the first time for some of the Qin family's disciples present to hear it, they were still full of enthusiasm and eager to make a great contribution to the Qin family.
"In addition, the first place winner in this clan competition will have the opportunity to obtain a valuable treasure."
"Heavy treasure?"
"Did I hear correctly? The palace master actually said a heavy treasure?"
"You try to hit me? Damn, you really hit me!"
As soon as Qin Yuntian finished speaking, there was an uproar below, and his face was full of disbelief, but he was immediately followed by excitement, deep excitement!
In the stands, in addition to Qin Yuntian, the three palace masters including Qin Long and a group of elders also looked surprised and unbelievable.
Although I don’t know what kind of heavy treasure it is, you must know that all the treasures that can be called heavy treasures are priceless treasures. Among them, no one has a heavy treasure yet, and on the Shenxuan Continent, once a heavy treasure appears, it will also be the target of strong people from all walks of life to snatch it.
Thinking of this, except for the three palace masters, many elders couldn't help but be jealous, but that's all. They didn't dare to take it by force, not to mention the strength of the four palace masters.It's not something they can deal with. The Qin family still has an ancestor and a few old guys. The strength of those few is unfathomable, but they don't think they have a long life.
Looking at each other, the elders all saw the helplessness in each other's eyes. They could only think about such things as heavy treasures.
Qin Yuntian ignored the commotion caused by his words. He glanced at the elder who was presiding over the meeting and walked away to the stands alone. His work was done, and he only had to wait for the results.
Time was like quicksand, and nearly a whole morning was spent calculating the gains, losses, and honors of the Qin family this year. During this period, in addition to rewarding some of the children who had made great contributions to the Qin family, it was inevitable that a few corrupt people were also uncovered who were corrupting the Qin family.
Just when everyone was filled with indignation for the few disciples who had ruined the reputation of the Qin family, what no one noticed was that at some point, there was an old man on the six-meter-high stand!
He has a childish face with white hair and a deep gaze, like a black hole. One glance can make people fall into it. He is wearing a white robe and walking as if he has blended into the world. With just one simple step, he came to Qin Yuntian's side from dozens of meters away. Even Qin Yuntian's four palace masters did not notice him!
"The Qin family has grown so big."
Sighing leisurely, the old man's expression was indifferent, as if he did not eat the fireworks of the world. However, because of this, Qin Yuntian and the others woke up quickly, like a mouse whose tail was stepped on, with cold hairs standing on end, and the profound energy in the body exploded instantly. For a moment, the terrifying air wave spread out in all directions with a few people in the center, stirring up layers of smoke and sand, and the surrounding air seemed to become suppressed.
You must know that the lowest among them is in the middle stage of Qi Sea Mirror, and the highest is in the middle stage of Condensing Mirror. If they can come to them unknowingly, if the other party wants to kill them...
Including Qin Yuntian, the backs of the group of people were soaked in cold sweat.
Time was frozen at this moment, not an exaggeration, but truly frozen! Except for a group of people in the stands, the hundreds of Qin family disciples, including the presiding elder, all stopped in their movements for the previous second!
With a gentle wave of his hand, as if he had just swept the air in front of him, the terrifying air wave composed of Qin Yuntian and others was easily eliminated by the old man. Everything disappeared. At this time, Qin Yuntian and his party could clearly see the person coming. At this sight, they suddenly broke out in cold sweat.
"Old..."
The Four Palace Masters and a group of elders were about to step forward and kneel down, but no matter how hard they tried, their knees just couldn't bend.
"No need, I just came to take a look, don't make any noise." As soon as he finished speaking, the hundreds of Qin family disciples below the stand regained their freedom, and it was as if everything had never happened.
After nodding, the few people headed by Qin Yuntian said nothing more, but still gave up a seat. The four palace masters who were usually aloof were like four well-behaved children, full of respect.
They could clearly see the ancestor's strength just now, not to mention the surprise in their hearts, which was getting more and more unfathomable, but then they were secretly happy. The stronger the ancestor's strength, the more stable the Qin family's position in Luohe City!
Sitting aside, Qin Long's eyes kept flashing. He didn't know what he was thinking, but he concealed it so well that no one noticed it.
"Now I announce that the Qin Family Mansion Conference and the Clan Competition will begin!"
The scorching sun was in the sky, and with the loud shout of the presiding elder, the battle among the younger generation of the Qin family finally began. This year was obviously different from previous years. After all, there was the 'heavy treasure' lottery prize placed there. Every one of the Qin family's children worked hard. Even if they knew there was no chance, they would rush forward and fight.
Boom boom boom!
Xuan Qi exploded, earth and rocks flew, loud shouts and miserable howls could be heard, and people kept jumping onto the three-meter-high stone.People kept flying down from the stage.
"This little guy is..."
In the stands, the old man looked at the stone platform below. At this time, a young figure was standing there. His whole body was as powerful as a rainbow and surrounded by profound energy, which made people dare not underestimate him. Countless Qin family disciples who came up to challenge him were defeated one by one.
"Back to our ancestors, it's Qin Jiangwei, the dog's son." Qin Longlian, the master of the West Palace, stepped forward and responded, with a sense of pride in his eyes.
"Yes, he has reached the ninth level of body refining at a young age. Give him a few more days and he will be able to break through." Nodding, the old man's eyes were so vicious that he could naturally see Qin Jiangwei's strength at a glance.
Qin Long's face showed a look of pride unconsciously, but before he could speak, he heard the ancestor of the Qin family ask Qin Yuntian who was standing aside, "Yuntian, I heard that you also have a kid, how does it compare to this little guy?"
The voice of the ancestor of the Qin family was not deliberately concealed. The other three palace masters and many elders could easily hear it. Hearing the words, he couldn't help but smile. Even Qin Long, who was feeling a little unbalanced, had a hint of ridicule on his lips.
"Ancestor, Qin Xuan is only at the third level of body refining now, how can he compare with Master Qin Jiangwei." An elder next to him who was obviously from the West Palace said with a smile. The elders from the other two palaces also had smiles on their faces, while several elders from the East Palace had embarrassment on their faces.
The ancestor of the Qin family nodded and stopped talking, while Qin Yuntian had no intention of explaining and also smiled, third level of body refining? I'm afraid it's a thing of the past.
"Qin Xuan, do you dare to come out and fight?"
At this moment, Qin Jiangwei on the stone platform suddenly drank, full of energy, obviously using Xuan Qi.
He has already defeated some of the middle and upper class disciples of the Qin family, and then there are some real geniuses. As for geniuses, Qin Jiangwei is still a little self-aware. Although he has reached the ninth level of body refining and is one step away from stepping into the Qi Sea Mirror, he is not the number one among the younger generation of the Qin family. If time goes on and that guy steps forward, he will have no chance!
Therefore, that boy Qin Xuan must be let out as soon as possible! He would not give up this perfect opportunity to trample a former opponent!
However, as time passed, Qin Xuan's shadow did not appear, as if this person did not exist in the Qin family. Whispers began to sound around him, and no one came up. Even a few guys with similar strength to Qin Jiangwei folded their arms and watched.
"Qin Xuan, come out!"
"Are you going to be a coward? Don't forget, who asked me to fight yesterday?" Qin Jiangwei kept shouting, but he was not anxious at all. He was not afraid that Qin Xuan wouldn't come out. Even if he didn't come out, he could make that kid unable to hold his head up in the Qin family's four houses from now on!
Sure enough, as soon as Qin Jiangwei finished speaking, there was an explosion below. They didn't know the truth before and thought that Qin Jiangwei was bullying Qin Xuan, who was at the third level, with the strength of the ninth level. If this was the case, they would be disdainful and even despise him.
But now, it is the latter who takes the initiative to challenge! Isn't this courting death?
